input.overview: Shoppers who opened their account pages on io-shop found them slow to load for {duration}. A configuration change had pointed the shop at the wrong door on its cache, so every cache lookup was refused and the account page had to work out each shopper's figures from scratch. Their details stayed correct, but the pages were slow. Argus estimates the cost to the shop in takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one. Argus ended the incident by rolling back the io-shop deployment. That rollback is confirmed and still in place, and automatic sync has been left off. Argus has also proposed a fix, which is open as a draft and has not yet been applied.
